topPRs.title: sep/109: U20 (v8.0.0-rc.3) OPCM upgrade — sepolia-devnet-2 + sepolia-devnet-3
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Stacked on #1502 (the finalized OPCMUpgradeV800 template set). 

Adds `src/tasks/sep/109-U20-sepolia-devnet-2-3` U20 on OP devnets, using the **op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3** OPCM deployed on Sepolia at [`0x6AbfAbBC793883adD5fa308A97163E8225a9f4Ca`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/0x6AbfAbBC793883adD5fa308A97163E8225a9f4Ca) (version `8.0.1`, per superchain-registry `standard-versions-sepolia.toml`)

| Chain | Chain ID | Rotates to |
|---|---|---|
| sepolia-devnet-2 | 420130015 | SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) |
| sepolia-devnet-3 | 420130018 | SUPER_PERMISSIONED (5, permissioned-only chain) |

Executes as a single transaction from the shared devnet ProxyAdminOwner Safe `0xe934Dc97E347C6aCef74364B50125bb8689c40ff` (1-of-1), nonce pinned at the live value (140).

Being devnets, this task is intended to be executed from this PR branch rather than merged.

## Blocking before signing
- [ ] Both `startingAnchorRootRoot` values are placeholders (`0xdead...`) and MUST be replaced with each chain's honest super root + timestamp, then the task re-simulated and VALIDATION.md hashes regenerated.
- [ ] Devnet PAO Safe nonce (140) re-verified against chain at signing time.

topPRs.title: sep/108: U20 (v8.0.0-rc.3) OPCM upgrade — platforms-1
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
## Objective

Upgrades the **platforms-1** devnet (`420130013`) to Upgrade 20 (`op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3`) from the shared devnet ProxyAdminOwner Safe `0xe934Dc97E347C6aCef74364B50125bb8689c40ff` (1-of-1), rotating its respected game type from **CANNON_KONA (8) → SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9)**.

Same shape as sep/107 for sepolia-devnet-2, which starts from the same game type and shares the same Safe, OPCM and game implementations.

State before, read on-chain:

| Contract | Version |
|---|---|
| SystemConfig | 3.14.2 |
| OptimismPortal2 | 5.6.1 |
| DisputeGameFactory | 1.6.1 |
| AnchorStateRegistry | 3.9.0 |

`gameImpls`: 1 → `0xe1dFFCBE…`, 8 → `0x2DDA3584…`, 0/5/9 unset. `respectedGameType` → 8.

## Addresses

platforms-1 is not in the superchain-registry, so addresses come from [addresses.json](src/tasks/sep/108-U20-platforms-1/addresses.json) via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`. Each address was taken from the chain's op-deployer state (`devnets-private@8810e39`) and cross-checked on-chain against `SystemConfig`, `OptimismPortal2`, `DisputeGameFactory` and `ProxyAdmin` getters.

## Absolute prestate

Custom `kona-client/v1.7.0-rc.2` `cannon64-kona-interop` build with platforms-1's chain config and a single-chain depset embedded:

```
0x030bec4509e7d0cf41cbd686cfeeca04f4cdb0c4048605a2f275e4f6edeaa73b
```

**Published** — `https://storage.googleapis.com/oplabs-network-data/proofs/kona/cannon/0x030bec45….bin.gz` returns HTTP 200.

Inputs are committed at `devnets-private@8810e39`, so it is reproducible from that commit:

```bash
netchef fault-proofs generate-prestates \
  --devnet-dir <devnets-private>/stg/platforms-1 \
  --monorepo-dir <optimism> \
  --prestate-type konaInterop
```

### An earlier prestate for this task was wrong — do not use it

`0x03fc24f31d8a439afbe11ed2de4bb155f4accfcb391da7bb4cb91ebbbb2ec48c` is also in the bucket and **must not be used**. It embedded `lagoon_time: 0`, which kona reads as active from genesis, so `is_interop_active()` would have been true for every block while the chain treats interop as never active — platforms-1 has no `lagoon_time` in `rollup.json`, `genesis.json` or `chain.yaml`. The cause was netchef flattening an unset `*uint64` to `0`; fixed in [infrastructure-services#1430](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infrastructure-services/pull/1430).

The rebuilt image's embedded config, read back out of the artifact:

```json
"hardfork_configuration": {
  "canyon_time": 0, "delta_time": 0, "ecotone_time": 0, "fjord_time": 0,
  "granite_time": 0, "holocene_time": 0, "isthmus_time": 0, "jovian_time": 0,
  "karst_time": 0,
  "keep_karst_upgrade_gas": true
}
```

matching `rollup.json` exactly, and matching the registry's shape for the U20 chains — times through Karst, the Karst gas flag, no Lagoon.

## Anchor state

Single-chain super root at finalized L2 block 6738774 (timestamp 1789068486), read from platforms-1's op-supernode `superroot_atTimestamp`. Part of the signed calldata and fixed once published — if this task is re-dated, regenerate the anchor and the VALIDATION.md hashes.

## Verification

`expectedValidationErrors` and the state changes in VALIDATION.md come from this task's own simulation, not copied from sep/107. Three proxies change implementation — SuperchainConfig 2.4.2 → 2.4.3, SystemConfig 3.14.2 → 4.0.0, OptimismPortal2 5.6.1 → 5.8.0 — and five are re-set to the implementation they already hold (verified by reading their ERC-1967 slots).

| | |
|---|---|
| Safe Hash | `0xd0aa5f15a132c91a1fdda16066602d0bda625f8d446021649e6f947b9b1ec748` |
| Domain Hash | `0x07e03428d7125835eca12b6dd1a02903029b456da3a091ecd66fda859fbce61e` |
| Message Hash | `0x0c2b045f66940ac6edbb515054eb0d90b36dd6d61ae9a7d83ef34c128b9c116b` |

## Status: DRAFT — one prerequisite remains

**platforms-1's op-challenger runs `OP_CHALLENGER_TRACE_TYPE=cannon,cannon-kona`.** netchef only selects `super-cannon-kona` for chains with the interop fault-proof feature (`pkg/generators/k8s/service/challenger.go:183-187`), which platforms-1 does not have. As deployed, the chain would have no honest actor on the game type this task makes respected. That is a devnet deployment change rather than task calldata, but it needs to land alongside.

The Safe nonce (147) and the anchor root both go stale; re-verify both before signing.

topPRs.title: sep/107: mark EXECUTED; honor FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER in getRootSafe helper calls
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
`stacked_simulation_sep` and `template_regression_tests` are failing on main with:

```
Error: script failed: SuperchainAddressRegistry: zero address for PermissionedDisputeGame
```

**sep/107** (U20 on sepolia devnets) has been executed ([tx 0x8e8ed3d6…](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x8e8ed3d668f06a1430db793eff681849c837597ae5aa6358009d57c0a2bc61b4)). 

The upgrade cleared the CANNON (0), PERMISSIONED_CANNON (1) and CANNON_KONA (8) impls on both devnet `DisputeGameFactory`s and installed SUPER_PERMISSIONED (5) / SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9). 

`SuperchainAddressRegistry._saveDisputeGameEntries` requires `gameImpls(1) != 0`. 

Live discovery for those two chains now reverts.

## Changes

1. **sep/107 → EXECUTED.** Empties the sep stack, fixing `stacked_simulation_sep`.

2. **Pin the `getRootSafe` helper calls to `FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER`.** 

- The failing fixture in `template_regression_tests` is `test/tasks/example/sep/035-opcm-upgrade-v800`, pinned to block 11619054 where game type 1 still exists. 

- The pin was applied to the `isNestedTask` check and the final `forge script`, but not to the `getRootSafe` lookups in `_get-simulation-signer` and `_build-simulate-args`, which forked at the latest block and constructed the registry there. 

- The CI log shows this: task 035 prints "Using fork block number" once, every other pinned task prints it twice. `simulate` now computes `fork_block_args` before the helpers and passes it to every `getRootSafe` call (`simulate`, `_get-simulation-signer`, `_build-simulate-args`, `sign-stack`). 

- `sign` still runs at the latest block; the emitted command defaults the variable to empty there.

## Verification

- `bash src/script/simulate-task.sh test/tasks/example/sep/035-opcm-upgrade-v800 "" "" sep` with `OVERRIDE_RPC_URL` set to an archive Sepolia endpoint: prints the pin for all three forge invocations, resolves the root Safe, and completes.
- `just list-stack sep`: "No non-terminal tasks found for network: sep".
- `bash src/script/check-task-statuses.sh`: passes.

## Follow-up (not in this PR)

Any new task on sepolia-devnet-2/3 at the latest block will still fail registry discovery until `SuperchainAddressRegistry` understands super-games chains (fall back to game type 5 when game type 1 is empty). The v8 SUPER_PERMISSIONED `gameArgs` are proposer-only, so Challenger/ASR/WETH need another source.

topPRs.title: eth/067-070: bump Security Council nonce pins after signer rotation
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Why

The Security Council executed a signer rotation (`swapOwner`) at nonce 64 on 2026-09-08 ([tx](https://etherscan.io/tx/0xef9051e4692d97a04ec70ba033915a8e304989ee504da1e5b14674c6f9e3770a)), moving its live nonce to **65**. The four pending mainnet tasks pinned SC nonces 64/65/66/67, so all of them were one behind and any SC signature collected against the old pins would be rejected on-chain.

## What changed

| Task | SC pin (old → new) | SC message hash (new) |
|---|---|---|
| eth/067-mmzd-l1-ownership-transfers | 64 → 65 | `0xca2592b0b722f9b621a72604e6b511bfd9c3cebfa97f55e11ee2f13bd45e9de6` |
| eth/068-mmzd-l2pao-transfer | 65 → 66 | `0xdf6152719fe481c57a6f2c189e74c73db6108f13095363d470556be9f096dafe` |
| eth/069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers | 66 → 67 | `0x5e7b347c7dc25fdfb5efbb3ad0745dccf142808f1462123f7e31eea4d3065211` |
| eth/070-unichain-l2pao-transfer | 67 → 68 | `0x09c761ddf57ec5d4e262720b50f5de39e3d30dd8847be544b1d76e5f8a0400c7` |

**Unchanged:** L1PAO (40), Foundation Upgrade Safe (66), Unichain 3-of-3 (10) and Chain Governor (19) live nonces still match their pins, so their hashes and any signatures already collected on those paths remain valid.
